title: Your First Weekend at Bellarmine University, Shared as Cards
description: A guide to the essential first-weekend experiences for new students at Bellarmine University, from move-in traditions to late-night social events.

cards.title: Check-In Central
cards.subtitle: The Official Start of Move-In
cards.notes: Arrive at Frazier Hall to collect your room keys and student ID. This central hub also hosts a resource fair with financial aid and advising staff.
cards.short_summary: The primary check-in location for new residential and commuter students during move-in weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Frazier Hall serves as the location for Check-In Central for first-year students during the Week of Welcome.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for first-year students; typically open from 8:30 AM to 2:30 PM on move-in Saturday.

cards.title: Family Lunch & Matriculation
cards.subtitle: Signing the Matriculation Book
cards.notes: Join the President for lunch and sign the official matriculation book, a tradition marking your formal entry into the Bellarmine community.
cards.short_summary: A formal welcome event where students sign the university's matriculation book.
cards.evidence_claim: The Family Lunch with the President includes the welcome and signing of the matriculation book at the University Dining Hall.
cards.access_notes: Held on Saturday of move-in weekend; families are welcome to attend.

cards.title: New Knight Social
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Games and Music
cards.notes: Head to historic Knights Hall for an evening of games, music, and food designed to help you meet your new classmates in a relaxed setting.
cards.short_summary: A Saturday evening social event for new students held in the university's primary athletic arena.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Student Social is held at Knights Hall on the Saturday of move-in weekend.
cards.access_notes: Typically starts at 6:30 PM on Saturday evening.

cards.title: Sparks at Knight
cards.subtitle: Fireworks and Carnival
cards.notes: Celebrate the start of the year with a carnival on the Quad featuring food trucks and games, culminating in a major fireworks display at 9:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: An annual welcome-back carnival and fireworks show held on the first Saturday of the fall semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Sparks at Knight is a welcome back carnival that takes place on the first Saturday of the fall semester and ends with fireworks.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; fireworks are visible from the hill behind the Dining Hall.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of the Woods Chapel
cards.title: Sunday Worship
cards.subtitle: Reflection in the Woods
cards.notes: Attend Sunday Mass or find a quiet moment for reflection at this scenic chapel located in a wooded area of campus.
cards.short_summary: The university's principal Roman Catholic chapel, offering Sunday services and a space for quiet meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: The community celebrates Mass in the Our Lady of the Woods Chapel on Sundays.
cards.source_title: About Our Lady of the Woods Chapel - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Open for prayer daily; Mass times are typically posted on the Campus Ministry site.

cards.title: SuRF Center Visit
cards.subtitle: Fitness and Recreation
cards.notes: Activate your membership at the Sport, Recreation, and Fitness Center. Use your student ID for free access to the gym, courts, and fitness classes.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for fitness, featuring a weight room, basketball courts, and intramural sports.
cards.evidence_claim: Membership to the SuRF Center is free for all current Bellarmine students with a valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday 12:00 PM - 7:00 PM during the fall semester.

cards.title: Late Night Dinner
cards.subtitle: Socializing Over Food
cards.notes: Join fellow students for a late-night meal at the UDH. It's a prime time for residential students to gather after evening orientation activities.
cards.short_summary: The main dining hall offers extended hours for social dining during the Week of Welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night Dinner is scheduled at the University Dining Hall from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM during move-in weekend.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM on Saturday of move-in weekend.

cards.title: Knights in Action
cards.subtitle: Community Service Day
cards.notes: Join your BU100 class for a morning of service at various nonprofit sites across Louisville, a signature tradition for all first-year students.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale service project where the entire first-year class volunteers at local nonprofits.
cards.evidence_claim: Knights in Action is a service project for the entire first-year class held at the end of the Week of Welcome.
cards.source_title: Signature Community Engagement Experiences - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for first-year students; transportation is typically provided from campus.

cards.title: Knights Soccer Game
cards.subtitle: Cheer on the Home Team
cards.notes: Experience the school spirit at Frazier Stadium. Catch a home soccer game and participate in the halftime contests and giveaways.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary outdoor athletic venue, hosting soccer and lacrosse matches.
cards.evidence_claim: Men's and Women's soccer games are held at Owsley B. Frazier Stadium, often featuring student events during the first week.
cards.access_notes: Check the athletics calendar for specific game times; student admission is typically free with ID.

cards.title: Library Exploration
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Study Space
cards.notes: Locate the 24-hour study room and collaborative spaces in the library. It's a great spot to organize your first week's syllabus and notes.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library, offering extensive resources and a dedicated 24-hour study area for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The W.L. Lyons Brown Library features a 24-hour study room available to students daily.
cards.source_title: W. L. Lyons Brown Library - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Main library hours vary; the 24-hour study room is accessible via student ID.
